text: Cluster 24 part 2 (#5936, stacked on PR #6715): built-in NULL propagation. Probed 139 built-ins x 9 NULL-argument positions on real VFP9 (retained vfp9-result-funcs.txt): ~100 numeric/string/date/bit/conversion functions return NULL for ANY NULL argument; exceptions are NULL-aware functions (ISNULL NVL EVL EMPTY ISBLANK VARTYPE TYPE TRANSFORM IIF INLIST BETWEEN), ISALPHA/ISDIGIT/ISLOWER/ISUPPER (.F.), and path functions (error 11). Implemented as one rule at the start of evaluate_function (set in is_null_propagating_builtin; scalar MIN/MAX only, so the one-argument SQL aggregate is untouched). Nullable-table run matches VFP9 exactly (CNN,XXXXX,1). Heads-up: LEN(nullfield) / UPPER(nullfield) are now NULL, as in VFP9.
